description: ARK: Survival Evolved - engrams, taming, and dossiers as Archipelago items/checks.

v0.1.0-alpha.description:
First public alpha of the ARK: Survival Evolved (Pre-Aquatica, The Island) integration for [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg). Engrams, taming, and supply crates are locked behind AP items; notes, tames, kills, breeding, levels, collection, and bosses send checks.

Setup: follow [docs/GETTING_STARTED.md](https://github.com/Jbaker16163/Ark-Survival-Archipelago/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md).

| `ark_ase.apworld` | the seed-generating machine |
| `ArkAP_plugin.zip` | the ARK dedicated server PC |
| `ArkConnector.zip` | the server PC |
| `ark_survival_evolved_ap.zip` (optional tracker) | any PC |

Alpha. ASE only (not ASA), Windows server only. All four files are built together always update them as a set. Multiplayer-on-one-server and dino spawn randomization are experimental.
v0.1.0-alpha.title: v0.1.0-alpha

v0.1.1-alpha.description:
Softlock prevention / progression logic

- Excluded progression from grind-heavy checks: 50+ note-collection milestones, tame/breed count milestones, levels >70, boss holograms, obscure note families (Genesis Chronicles, HLN-A, ??? Notes), water alphas → all alphas, tame-only late-game dossiers (Rhyniognatha, Carcharodontosaurus).
- Gated tough kills (water/apex creatures, Unicorn, Kill 50+/100 Species) so they hold later progression instead of sitting at sphere 1.
- Removed Acrocanthosaurus (not an ASE creature).
- Embedded /connect + /confirm restart chain

- /confirm now reliably restarts the server if randomized dino is enabled.
- Wild creatures(only happens with /confirm for randomize dinos) now actually get wiped on that restart via -ForceRespawnDinos.
- Fixed the connect/rejoin status message never appearing (detection now keys off actual login/logout, with a short delay so chat can render).
- Fixed <host:port> rendering as an emoji in chat.

- Reset_ark_test.bat now wipes per-player mailboxes and strips leftover randomized-spawn lines from Game.ini.

- Retired the old ArkConnector.zip. We will now be using /connect in game. 

**Thank you Lurch9229 for providing proper logic. Will continue to work with him to refine logic and fix softlocks.**

v0.1.5-alpha.description:
- Added 45 exploration checks - fly to a region and it checks. Biomes, mountains, islands, caves, all three obelisks, and a Deep Ocean one that only fires when you actually dive.
- Added 10 death checks. Carnivore, herbivore, alpha, cold, heat, drowning, lava, falling, starvation, dehydration. Go on. Die.
- Added milestones for dying (1/5/10/25/40), exploring (5/10/15/20/25 regions), and taming or killing a high-level creature. The level ones scale to YOUR server difficulty, so they work whether your max wild is 30 or 150.
- Fixed Campfire arriving as an item and unlocking absolutely nothing. 
- Fixed Campfire ALSO being placed in the pool when free starter engrams was already switched on, so you got an unlock for something you already had.
- Fixed Plant Species X Seed and Leech Blood never sending their checks - both were looking for the wrong item internally. You can hold 100 of them and nothing would happen. Achatina Paste and Element Dust had the same problem in filler.
- Fixed underwater dossiers being reachable without scuba - a single tamed Diplocaulus was counting as deep diving gear. 12 notes could hold progression you had no way to get to(added tame logic for the diplocaulus to require crossbow+tranq arrows).
- Multiplayer FALSE now properly unlocks for everyone on the server. Engrams and tames already did, but filler, buffs and traps were only going to whoever happened to load in first.(not tested, get to work tester bees)
- Unlock messages now say who the unlock is for and list every item you got, not just the first one. Paired engrams, bundled saddles and grouped items all show properly now.
- Fixed losing your tames and engrams after a server restart. Also fixed the follow-up where it handed you your entire item history back, filler and all.(nasty bug, sorry I didn't catch this before the last build)
- Added /apcheck, /apdumpinv, /apresync, /aprecover and /dumppos.
- Added additional logic from Lurch. 

**Upgrading: replace the WHOLE plugin folder, not just the dll - the data files changed too. You also need to regenerate your seed. If you use multiplayer true, everyone should /connect once.**

Once again big thanks to Lurch, Beeno, Avocado, and Brandon. Attached once again is Avocado's Launcher. USE IT! It makes life much easier(or so I am told). https://github.com/aSoberAvocado/ARK-Ipelago-Evolved-Launcher/releases#release-v0.4.4

v0.1.6-alpha.description:
**Item Delivery**

- Fixed engrams that were recorded as unlocked but never became craftable. Happened when the item arrived while you were dead or respawning; the log said it succeeded.
- Fixed items that Archipelago awarded and the game never received at all. Two causes: an item index was marked delivered before its line reached disk, and a lost line could not be replayed.
- Items now WAIT for you. Anything that arrives while you are dead or offline is held and delivered when you are back on your feet, instead of being applied to nobody(bug with new connector system).
- Fixed babies not being claimable in multiplayer ("Taming is locked for this creature"). Also affected cryopod and soul-ball releases.
- Fixed checks being lost when the game could not tell which survivor earned them.

**Engrams**

- Fixed 40 engrams that could never be unlocked(weird bug once again), Stimulant among them. They were also being retried every tick forever - one server log reached 238 MB, roughly half of it that retry.

**QOL**

- The plugin version is now shown in chat on connect, on join, and in `/apstatus`.(let's start normalizing sending me logs if you are receiving a bug)

**Maps**

- Added early support for Scorched Earth and Ragnarok, what is currently done is their creatures, engrams, bosses, artifacts, supply drops, and explorer notes(I am sure something is missed here, like I said early). 
- 31 exploration regions on scorched earth, 37 on Ragnarok
- Very early here, I have not tested much for logic on this, should not be used in a long term run but for testing, it should be fine. 

**Upgrading: replace the WHOLE plugin folder, not just the dll - the data files changed too. You also need to regenerate your seed. If you use multiplayer true, everyone should /connect once.**

Once again big thanks to Lurch, Beeno, Avocado, and Brandon. Attached once again is Avocado's Launcher. USE IT! It makes life much easier(or so I am told). https://github.com/aSoberAvocado/ARK-Ipelago-Evolved-Launcher/releases/tag/v0.4.8
